variants.name: 04-bd-ligne-claire
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: family portrait for an illustrated digital book, portrait 3:4, one standalone image.
Input image 1 is the original photo, edit target and identity reference. Redraw these exact FOUR family members as a genuinely hand-drawn cartoon, not a photo filter. Preserve recognizable facial characteristics, skin tones, ages, hair, smiles and original arrangement: mother at left wearing black sunglasses and olive-green dress, father behind wearing round glasses, short hair and goatee, white shirt and navy trousers, holding baby at right in light outfit and yellow bib; daughter in foreground with braids and yellow dress, arms crossed. Keep the original mirror-selfie phone and hands readable and natural. Keep all four faces fully visible and comfortably framed. Simplify the room into a light uncluttered backdrop. No text, logos, watermarks, extra characters, book mockup or UI. Keep the likeness while deliberately simplifying anatomy and details into appealing drawn shapes.
Primary request: crisp Franco-Belgian comic-book ligne claire family portrait. Confident thin dark ink contours, beautifully simplified facial features with clear individual likeness, flat solid colors and only one simple shadow tone. Neat graphic hair and fabric shapes, cheerful expressive line drawings, warm brown skin, olive green and yellow clothing. Off-white background. Strong clean drawn character design, absolutely no realistic photographic shading, no paper collage or watercolor. A single unified portrait, no panels or speech bubbles.
